description.value: Pizza Factory is a long-established Coquitlam pizzeria founded in 1984 by Sam Sanghera, now operating as a franchise with locations across British Columbia. The Clarke Road location hand-makes fresh dough daily and offers a wide menu spanning specialty pizzas, pasta, chicken wings, and Indian-inspired dishes. With 528 customer reviews and both pickup and delivery available, it is a well-used neighbourhood food stop.
